summary: @servicetitan/startup-utils preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload unrelated to declared purpose
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from Bun's official GitHub releases, extracts and chmod +x the binary, then invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB obfuscated bundle at the tarball root using a string-array rotator (WV8StW) and custom-alphabet decoder (hc1jfK9). The package's declared purpose is minimal "uikit version-mismatch helpers" and its dist/index.js is only 601 bytes of _export_star; math_init.js is not referenced from the declared main or the files list (dist, src) and has no relationship to the advertised uikit utilities. Runtime endpoints are reconstructed from the encoded string pool rather than appearing as plaintext. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a smuggled obfuscated bundle at preinstall matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and evades Node-graph static analysis.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
